links.outcome: LLM accuracy extracting epilepsy surgery referral information from clinic notes, and error types
links.effect: LLM accuracy ranged 80% to 100% across 7 prompts; errors were most frequent when summarising the management plan and included hallucinations, omissions and copying erroneous information.
links.quote: Errors included hallucinations, omissions, and copying erroneous information.

unlisted_practices: Periodic (e.g., quarterly) ML risk stratification of clinic patients with manual case-note review of the top 5% to identify epilepsy surgery candidates

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic/screening performance of a random forest model paired with an LLM for identifying epilepsy surgery candidates in an emulated/retrospective clinic review setting, but does not compare or test specific guardrails or deployment practices.
